assumptions: The Shine-Dalgarno hybridisation and competing mRNA folding are the model's terms, folded under Turner 2004.
A bacterial host with the 16S anti-SD sequence the model uses.
limits: A relative strength, not a measured protein yield.
Reads an existing 5'UTR; design_rbs writes one.
bio.jane/contract.question: How strong is the ribosome-binding site already in front of this start codon, and what sets that strength?

description: Score the ribosome-binding site already in front of a start codon: the Shine-Dalgarno hybridisation energy, the mRNA folding that competes with it, the spacing it implies, and the resulting relative initiation strength. This reads an existing 5'UTR — design_rbs writes a new one.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

mrna.description: the mRNA (or DNA) carrying the UTR and the CDS — leave unset to use the open record.

start_pos.description: 0-based position of the start codon's first base within `mrna`.

name: score_rbs

dgHybrid.description: Shine-Dalgarno · anti-SD hybridisation energy (null when no Shine-Dalgarno could be placed)

dgMrna.description: folding energy of the mRNA window that competes with initiation

dgTotal.description: total free energy of the initiation state (null when no Shine-Dalgarno could be placed)

sdLength.description: length of that Shine-Dalgarno, in bases (null when no Shine-Dalgarno could be placed)

sdStart.description: 0-based position in `mrna` where the winning Shine-Dalgarno begins (null when none could be placed)

spacing.description: bases between the Shine-Dalgarno and the start codon (null when no Shine-Dalgarno could be placed)

structure.description: dot-bracket secondary structure of the folded initiation window (empty when the window is too short to fold)

structureStart.description: 0-based position in `mrna` that the first character of `structure` sits on
